findings.issue: SCAN had no exact result plan for BACK present with the value false
findings.resolution: SCAN('FORTRAN','TR') and BACK=.FALSE. give 3, BACK=.TRUE. gives 5

findings.issue: SELECTED_REAL_KIND collapsed result codes -1 to -4 into one no-oracle claim
findings.resolution: separate facets per code; -1/-2/-3 via P and/or R = HUGE(0) under a stated assumption that no kind has that precision/range; -4 no-oracle (no portable construction); -5 via an unsupported RADIX

findings.issue: the tie-rule plan did not observe selection among multiple matching kinds
findings.resolution: PRECISION(REAL(0, SELECTED_REAL_KIND(P=PRECISION(0.0)))) == PRECISION(0.0) (and double) observes the smallest-precision rule; the final smallest-kind-value tiebreak is no-oracle

findings.issue: SET_EXPONENT plan named no concrete inputs
findings.resolution: X = 3.0 and -0.75 with named exponents, FRACTION preserved and EXPONENT == I, plus SET_EXPONENT(0.0, I) == 0.0
